time_unit: days in supplied TCGA-CDR clinical fields; OS independently crosschecked against explicit day fields

PFI.event: earliest new tumour event including progression, locoregional recurrence, distant metastasis, new primary tumour, or death with tumour
PFI.censor: last contact if event-free; death date if died without tumour
PFI.field: PFI and PFI.time; not PFI.1 or PFI.2
PFI.limitation: curated inclusive PFI definition, not treatment-specific trial PFS; underlying special-case event dates not fully reconstructed

DFI: not selected for primary analyses; disease-free eligibility differs from OS/PFI
DSS: not selected for primary analyses; approximate for most cancers
